Gap (minor, real): 0a's order is act, reply, then 'After each: Activity'. A crash after the Task row is written loses the Activity and possibly the reply for good. 0a2 keys on the 'Akshay to Zoya on WhatsApp' Activity, so no done/handed-over report ever follows; Akshay may never hear his @zoya was taken. Suggested fix: 'a Task row with that key but no Activity: log the Activity and post the reply, create nothing'.
Same gap for the 0a a path is the opposite way: a Your call write carries no key, so a crash before the Activity re-appends his words next run (pre-existing in 0a, now inherited by 0a1).

Fails both filters: 'Take only his fromMe text messages that start "@zoya"' and 'never one starting "zoya here" or "Zoya ✨" (your own posts)'. 0d replies are fromMe and contain '@zoya', so this exclusion is load-bearing and present. Same filter keeps 0a1's own 'Zoya ✨ re your @zoya...' posts out.
